title: 12-Lead ECG
author: A. Shah, MD
summary: Sinus tachycardia 122, PR 150 ms, QRS 86 ms, QTc 432 ms (Fridericia). Mildly prominent symmetric T waves, narrow QRS, no ischemic changes (potassium 5.3 at 0200).
body:
**Measurements**
Ventricular rate 122 bpm. PR 150 ms. QRS 86 ms. QTc 432 ms (Fridericia).

**Interpretation**
Sinus tachycardia. Mildly prominent, symmetric T waves with a narrow QRS. P waves present, PR and QRS normal: no sign of significant hyperkalemia. No ST or T-wave pattern of ischemia, no arrhythmia.

**Context**
DKA, potassium 5.3 at 0200 (resulted 0215). This mild elevation need not produce dramatic ECG changes. Insulin will move potassium into the cells and total body potassium is low: no potassium in the first two bags, recheck at 0445.
impression: Sinus tachycardia 122 with mildly prominent symmetric T waves, consistent with potassium 5.3. QTc 432 ms.

title: 12-Lead ECG
author: R. Okonkwo, MD
summary: Sinus rhythm 96, PR 158 ms, QRS 86 ms, QTc 460 ms (Fridericia). Flattened T waves with small distinct U waves, no ectopy (potassium 3.2, magnesium 1.6 at 0745).
body:
**Measurements**
Ventricular rate 96 bpm. PR 158 ms. QRS 86 ms. QTc 460 ms (Fridericia; the U wave is identified separately and not included in the QT).

**Interpretation**
Sinus rhythm. Flattened T waves with small, distinct U waves best seen in V2-V3. No ventricular ectopy. Compared with 0205: rate slower (122 to 96), the prominent T waves are gone and a low-potassium pattern has appeared.

**Context**
Potassium 5.3 (0200), 4.0 (0445), 3.6 (0645), 3.2 (0745, reported 0800) and magnesium 1.6 on the insulin infusion. Correct both deficits and keep her on telemetry. Never infer a normal potassium from the ECG alone.
impression: Sinus rhythm 96. Flattened T waves and small U waves, consistent with potassium 3.2 and magnesium 1.6. QTc 460 ms.

title: 12-Lead ECG
author: R. Okonkwo, MD
summary: Normal sinus rhythm 88, PR 160 ms, QRS 84 ms, QTc 438 ms (Fridericia). Normal T-wave contour, no U waves, no conduction abnormality (potassium 3.9, magnesium 1.9 at 1845).
body:
**Measurements**
Ventricular rate 88 bpm. PR 160 ms. QRS 84 ms. QTc 438 ms (Fridericia).

**Interpretation**
Normal sinus rhythm. Normal T-wave contour with no distinct U waves. No conduction abnormality, no ectopy, no ST changes. Compared with 0805: the flat T waves and U waves have resolved and the QTc is shorter.

**Context**
Potassium 3.9 and magnesium 1.9 on the 1845 specimen (released 1900), after the potassium and magnesium replacement. No later 12-lead ECG is planned unless symptoms or electrolyte abnormalities return.
impression: Normal sinus rhythm 88. Normal T waves, no U waves. QTc 438 ms.
